'''Popara's penthouse''' was a penthouse that was located in a tower on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]], who on occasion held a party there.
